original_method: Resolve the CPU1 PVDDCR, P-index and C semantics, enumerate all expected CPU1 rail-current channels and immutable raw/UI identities, collect complete value/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized CPU1 voltage, package power, utilization/frequency and VR health/temperature context, and compare each result to the CPU1 owner contract without assuming CPU0 symmetry.

Bind every reading to CPU1 and its physical rail/phase/domain with synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overcurrent/undercurrent, CPU1/VR/thermal fault, impossible unit/value, missing/duplicate mapping or BMC error
